Chapter 409: Chapter 18 Advancing Into The Eighth Layer (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 409: Chapter 18 Advancing into the Eighth Layer (Please Subscribe)

At this very moment,

a vast Spirit Will coalesced within Lin Yuan,

making him feel as if everything he saw was like an illusory bubble, easily popped with a touch.

Rustle…

In the instant Lin Yuan regained consciousness,

his awareness began to sink once again.

...

By the time Lin Yuan opened his eyes again, he had already arrived in the Cosmic Starry Skies.

The powerful aura of different species chased after him, Lin Yuan was clearly being hunted down.

“Hahaha, no matter if you are a peerless genius of Human Civilization, you will still die,” the different species chasing behind him laughed maniacally.

“I am being chased?”

Lin Yuan frowned and subconsciously thought to continue fleeing for his life.

The next moment,

the vast Spirit Will once again coalesced inside him.

This allowed Lin Yuan to instantly understand his situation.

“Just a Heart Demon…” Lin Yuan stopped his escape as the Illusionary Realm around him began to collapse again.

…

The essence of the Heart Demon Tribulation is the Heart Demon itself. Evolvers, when facing the Heart Demon Tribulation, will experience scenes they least wish to encounter.

Or ones they are most willing to encounter.

For example, Lin Yuan was most concerned about being killed by the different species before he could grow.

Normally, if one’s Spirit Will is not up to standard, they would easily get lost in the layers upon layers of illusion, meaning a failure in transcending the Heart Demon Tribulation.

But a strong Spirit Will can allow an Evolver to quickly wake up.

Or make the Evolver realize that everything around them is an illusion, all fabricated.

If they do, the probability of surpassing the Heart Demon Tribulation greatly increases.

In the blink of an eye,

Lin Yuan shattered hundreds of Heart Demon illusions.

…

With a change of scene,

An Insect Race Hive, rivaling a galaxy in size, appeared in the distance,

Seventh Rank, Eighth Layer, and even Ninth Rank Insect Race Warriors created by the Hive charged out one after another.

“Is this an Insect Queen?”

A shock went through Lin Yuan’s heart.

The Insect Queen corresponded to a Supreme Being of Human Civilization.

An Insect Queen could endlessly produce a vast number of Seventh, Eighth, and Ninth Rank Insect Race Warriors.

These Insect Race Warriors, one-on-one, are definitely not a match for Evolvers of the same rank.

But they are endless in number, and the mere sight of millions of ordinary Eighth Layer Insect Race Warriors would make even the Chikun Star Lord’s scalp tingle.

It’s precisely for this reason that in the war between Human Civilization and the Insect Race, there is no advantage, rather a disadvantage, in the mid-to-low end battles.

Only at the level of Supreme Beings is the fight dominated by the Human side, as the Insect Queens are suppressed by the Supreme Beings.

This is because the Insect Queens are incapable of creating Supreme Being level warriors.

“The Insect Queen taking action against me personally is too far-fetched,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. Even without a powerful Spirit Will, he felt the scene before him was somewhat absurd. The Matriarchs were beings that could stand up to Supreme Beings.

Even the Evolvers, peerless geniuses of an era among humans, were not worth the effort of a Matriarch’s direct intervention, given their status and position.

Booming…

As the massive Spirit Will gathered,

Lin Yuan once again crushed this layer of Heart Demon illusion.

…

At the summit of a towering and majestic Evolution Tower,

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his aura now as deep as the Cosmic Starry Sky, and wherever his gaze landed, it was within the boundaries of his own territory.

“Great Supreme Being, under your leadership, Human Civilization has become an unprecedented force in the Cosmic Starry Sky, and clans like the Insect Race have submitted one after another…” said an elder below, his voice filled with deep worship.

“Becoming a Supreme Being, leading Human Civilization to its peak, is something every human Evolver desires to accomplish…”

At this moment, Lin Yuan was enduring the worship of countless humans, looking down from on high, like a deity.

“Too bad, it’s all fake,” Lin Yuan sighed. The scenes in all directions began to collapse, taking with them the invincible power that filled Lin Yuan’s body as well.

…

Atop a high mountain,

Lin Yuan silently opened his eyes.

“The Heart Demon Tribulation… has ended.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound, as if he had broken through some kind of shackles, and his spiritual realm suddenly began to sublimate.

“My current realm… has reached the Eighth Layer.”

There are three prerequisites to becoming an Eighth Layer Evolver.

One is the Heart Demon Tribulation, the second is the Inner World, and the third is the Physical Soul reaching the pinnacle of perfection.

Without transcending the Heart Demon Tribulation, one will always be just a Seventh Layer at its pinnacle; even if both the Inner World and Physical Soul meet the requirements, it is useless.

Because the realm cannot be elevated.

Only after passing through the Heart Demon Tribulation is it possible to ascend smoothly to the Eighth Layer in terms of realm.

After that, if the Inner World is opened and the Physical Soul reaches perfection, one can formally step into the Eighth Layer.

“End the traversal.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the remaining residence time.

Five years were left.

The countless layers of Heart Demon illusions Lin Yuan experienced in the Heart Demon Tribulation were but an instant in reality.

As for the remaining five years of traversing worlds, there was no need to spend them here.

The most important thing for Lin Yuan now was to fully step into the Eighth Layer.

…

On the Chikun Main Star,

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

Rustle…

A large amount of Red Spirit Fluid appeared in front of him.

Years ago, Lin Yuan began preparing for his ascent to the Eighth Layer, and of course, he hadn’t forgotten the Red Spirit Fluid.

“Breakthrough.”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes.

Booming…

First came the expansion of the Inner World, which began to expand wildly once more.

The Inner World, originally thirteen thousand li in radius, suddenly surged to a radius of twenty-five thousand li.

The explosive expansion of the Inner World didn’t cause much commotion.

Previously, when Lin Yuan expanded his Inner World from ten-plus li to a radius of twelve thousand li,

a ten-thousand-fold increase, Lin Yuan could not control it perfectly, so he asked the Chikun Star Lord for help in concealing it.
